label: preparing
what: A secret surprise feast for the mayor's forty years of service: preparing 200 fresh loaves, installing eight lanterns in the great hall, and arranging for the mayor to arrive at 18:00 on day 1. The mayor was not told the true purpose; the neighbour arranged the cover meeting and escort. The record shows the mayor was informed only of an ordinary meeting, not the feast. 200 loaves and the lanterns were completed and kept reserved.
